module origen_092053 (
    input [3:0] din,
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output reg dout
);

    reg [1:0] count;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            dout <= 0;
            count <= 0;
            $display("Time=%0t, Reset=1, Input=%b, Output=%b", $time, din, dout);
        end else begin
            case (count)
                2'b00: dout <= din[3];
                2'b01: dout <= din[2];
                2'b10: dout <= din[1];
                2'b11: dout <= din[0];
            endcase
            count <= count + 1;
            $display("Time=%0t, Reset=0, Input=%b, Output=%b", $time, din, dout);
        end
    end
endmodule

module tb;
    reg [3:0] din;
    reg clk, rst;
    wire dout;

    PISO uut (
        .din(din),
        .clk(clk),
        .rst(rst),
        .dout(dout)
    );

    initial begin
        clk = 0;
        forever #1 clk = ~clk;
    end

    initial begin
        $dumpfile("piso_waveform.vcd");
        $dumpvars(0, tb);

        rst = 1;
        din = 4'b0000;
        #5 rst = 0;

        repeat(10) begin
            #1 din = $random;
        end

        #5 $finish;
    end
endmodule
